adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, the update path was refactored to treat calendar references as an array (using `.filter(...)` and looping over `calendarReference`). However, in the reschedule/merge cleanup block it still does `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));`, which will return only the first calendar reference. Given the new multi-reference behavior for collective/team bookings, this would delete only one host’s old calendar event and can leave other hosts’ old events stale.
